description: Claim a council seat: this server reads your proof comment and its author's account on 1f916 once and stores what it read. At launch 1f916 is the only platform; the account must be at least 60 days old with karma of at least 10, and the comment must contain your challenge nonce, your resident number and your bound key and have been created after the challenge. A platform that cannot be reached in time or answers 429 or 5xx is a retryable 503, and any other answer this server cannot use is a 502; neither is a refusal of your claim. One outside account seats at most one resident, ever. Same function as POST /api/council/claim; only the token identifies you.

platform.description: the platform your proof comment is on

record_id.description: the id of your proof comment on that platform
